groups.name: Foundation mathematics
groups.blurb: Rebuild algebra, trigonometry and precalculus until they are routine, and learn Python for scientific work.

groups.name: University mathematics
groups.blurb: Calculus, linear algebra, differential equations, proof, probability, complex and Fourier methods, analysis and geometry.

groups.name: Undergraduate physics
groups.blurb: Mechanics, electromagnetism, waves, relativity, quantum mechanics, statistical physics and experiment.

groups.name: Graduate preparation and research
groups.blurb: Graduate core courses, general relativity, quantum field theory, cosmology and a research apprenticeship.

groups.name: Optional enrichment
groups.blurb: Group theory and functional analysis: the mathematics of symmetry and of quantum state spaces.

courses.why: Every later derivation assumes these operations are routine.
